scripts.server:dashboard: turbo build --filter=@pallastrade/cli && VITE_BASE_PATH=/dashboard/ pnpm --dir packages/dashboard-starter build
scripts.server:dev: PALLASTRADE_GEMS_PATH=$PWD docker compose -f server/docker-compose.dev.yml -f scripts/docker-compose.edge.yml up --force-recreate web worker
scripts.server:restart: PALLASTRADE_GEMS_PATH=$PWD docker compose -f server/docker-compose.dev.yml -f scripts/docker-compose.edge.yml restart web worker
scripts.server:stop: PALLASTRADE_GEMS_PATH=$PWD docker compose -f server/docker-compose.dev.yml -f scripts/docker-compose.edge.yml down
